parsed.why: Nationwide 14-year criminalisation, death penalty under northern Sharia, predatory police extortion for 'looking gay', mass venue raids, app-based blackmail gangs, and an unprosecuted trans killing with official misgendering.

New penal code criminalises all same-sex relations; president's decree frames LGBTQ+ as national-defense threat; vigilante mobs attacking trans women, villa raids, caning province, dating-app bans, and a trans traveller dead in custody.

Self-declaration recognition, hate-crime and hate-speech bans, marriage equality, working courts recognising hate motive, welcoming travel guidance. Downsides are dating-app ambush robberies and high harassment prevalence — real but with functioning recourse.

Birth-sex prison placement with documented abuse, police non-cooperation, gangs extorting LGBT people, hospitals denying care, and a survey finding 85% accepting attacks on trans people — tempered by hate-crime law and a landmark police-conviction.

Strong anti-discrimination law, prosecuted hate crimes, and court safeguards for detained trans foreigners, offset by head-of-state hostility, 43-51% discrimination/assault prevalence highest among trans people, and unresolved prison placement rules.
